bug_description: capitalize_words uses .upper() on the rest of the word instead of .lower().

gold_patch.old_text: return " ".join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].upper() if w else "" for w in s.split(" "))
gold_patch.new_text: return " ".join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].lower() if w else "" for w in s.split(" "))
